"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"10. Claude's slash commands and skills show up in dsh's slash menu under their own names, as `/claud"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"e-<name>` where dsh already uses the name. - **Reads**"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" Claude Code's login (`~/.claude/.credentials.json`, on macOS the `Claude Code-credentials` Keychain"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" entry when that file has no live token, or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` when set) to fetch the model list an"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"d your plan usage. That token goes only to `api.anthropic.com`.
- **Writes** its own state under `~/"},{"id":"p18s5","text":".local/state/dsh-oh-my-claude/`; login tokens for SSH boxes are files only you can read. CLAUDE.md, "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"settings.json and MCP servers change only when you edit them from the panel.
- **Listens** on a Unix"},{"id":"p18s7","text":" socket for the keeper that holds Claude across a dsh restart. Its HTTP routes live inside dsh's own"},{"id":"p18s8","text":" server, so on DSH Web it opens no TCP port. Under DSH Desktop, whose web server answers 403 to anyt"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"hing but its own window, the bridge that hands dsh's tools to Claude also listens on 127.0.0.1, behi"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"nd the same key.
- **Calls out** to `api.anthropic.com` (models, plan usage), `status.anthropic.com`"},{"id":"p18s11","text":", `downloads.claude.ai` (the CLI's release pointer), `registry.npmjs.org` (plugin update check) and "},{"id":"p18s12","text":"`api.github.com` (the repo's star count). SSH goes only to boxes you add."}],"truncated":true}
